links.outcome: Readability of existing online patient education materials after LLM plain-language rewriting
links.effect: Original online PEMs FKGL 9.7 and SMOG 10.3; after rewriting ChatGPT-4o FKGL 5.8, ChatGPT-3.5 7.7, Gemini 7.5 (p<0.001).
links.quote: Using prompt C, the three LLMs significantly improved the readability of existing online educational resources, as evidenced by a marked enhancement in average readability scores ( p ≤ 0.001) (Fig. 2 ).
